name: vibed-puppet
postCreateCommand: wget -q -O /tmp/chrome.deb https://dl.google.com/linux/direct/google-chrome-stable_current_amd64.deb && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y /tmp/chrome.deb && rm /tmp/chrome.deb && npm install
postAttachCommand: echo 'Open the Ports tab -> port 6080 -> globe icon (password: vscode). Then run: npm run start:codespace'
